query: If I do not intend to renew my licence, do I need to settle my outstanding MediSave payable?
reference_answer: You’re required to pay your outstanding MediSave payable even if you do not intend to renew your licence.

The MediSave payable is based on your annual net trade income (NTI) derived as a self-employed person and not the number of licences. If you have a total yearly NTI of more than $6,000 from your licence(s), you are required to make contributions to your MediSave Account.
answer: Even if you don't intend to renew your licence, you still need to settle your outstanding MediSave payable as per [Document 1]. MediSave payable is based on your annual net trade income, not the number of licences. [Document 1] clearly states this requirement.
